summary: Iteration 5 — YouTube Data API v3 search feature: backend endpoint GET /api/youtube/search validated (auth required, 400 on empty query, results include youtube_id/title/channel_name/thumbnail, second identical call served instantly by 15-min in-memory cache). Frontend Add screen validated end-to-end on mobile viewport 390x844: Recherche tab is default, typing 'squeezie' returns 15 result cards (~1s after debounce), tapping a result shows the preview 'Vidéo sélectionnée - Prête à noter !' with Favoris + Changer buttons. Rating via StarRating pan responder, comment input, then 'Publier ma note' triggers 'Avis publié !' modal and returns home. AddToPlaylistModal opens correctly (empty-state visible for testcode user). 'Changer' clears the preview and keeps the search input. URL mode regression OK with Rick Astley test URL. Backend 4/4 pytest passed. No critical issues. No deprecated Expo packages detected in server.py or add.tsx.

ui_bugs.issue: The 'Vous n'avez pas encore de playlist' empty state redirects to Profile to create one — the review request mentions 'liste des playlists ou création' which suggests inline creation would be nicer UX. Not a blocker.
Close button (X) has no testID. Consider adding testID='close-playlist-modal-btn' for test stability.

action_items: OPTIONAL: add inline 'Créer une playlist' CTA inside AddToPlaylistModal when the user has 0 playlists (currently redirects to profile).
OPTIONAL: add testID on the AddToPlaylistModal close (X) button for test stability.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown large (>1500 lines). Consider splitting into routers (auth, videos, playlists, friends, moderation) for maintainability.

_youtube_search_cache is a naive in-memory dict that clears entirely once size > 200. For a shared multi-instance deployment this cache is per-process; consider Redis or a proper LRU (cachetools.TTLCache) — non-blocking for MVP but worth noting.
Add screen (/app/frontend/app/(tabs)/add.tsx) mixes URL and search state; refactoring into two child components would improve readability.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data. Reused verified testcode@example.com / test123. One TEST_ rating created during flow validation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New YouTube search feature fully validated. Backend endpoint /api/youtube/search works with real YouTube Data API v3 key configured in backend/.env; a 15-minute in-memory cache preserves the daily quota. Frontend Add screen exposes testIDs: tab-search (default), tab-url, youtube-search-input, youtube-url-input, search-result-<youtube_id>, add-to-playlist-btn, change-video-btn, comment-input, submit-rating-btn. StarRating exposes only star-rating-container (uses PanResponder) — no per-star testIDs; use bounding_box + mouse.click at ~72% width for ~4 stars.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found this iteration.
